cleanupEvidence: Final supervisor observations and actual reader cleanup receipts recorded within the execution context
limitations: New exec calls have separate/limited PID namespace visibility; later /proc absence cannot prove original execution-context cleanup.
Launch PID namespace ID was not captured before execution. PIDs are local to the actual launch context, not global host identities.
The earlier surviving-work audit observed no prior processes only within its observer visibility; it did not prove no external or inaccessible worker existed.
Sampling can miss short-lived children. Command outcomes, wrapper/driver receipts and reader receipts overlap; do not add them as an exhaustive total.
